_comment: FULL DUMMY WEBSITE SETTINGS TEMPLATE. Copy manually to settings/settings.json only when creating a new private runtime config. This tracked example contains placeholders only and is never loaded directly by the application. Never replace an existing runtime settings.json with it.

app._comment: General website runtime behavior. Keep a different settings/settings.json for Laragon and Production.

databases._comment: Website database profiles only. Do not add GLOBAL_weaponpaints here: WeaponPaints is reached only through the signed Linux API. The extends setting inherits another profile, while name can select a separate schema.

main._comment: Main FragCity website DB. Use local Laragon credentials here; configure the shared-hosting Production credentials only in that host's private runtime file. Prefer a least-privilege DB user rather than root.
main.name: kyonxcbt_fragcity_services

plugin_sync._comment: Optional separate schema for plugin synchronization. Leave name empty until the schema and permissions are intentionally provisioned.

legacy_services._comment: Compatibility profile for older site pages. This currently inherits main; change it only if a separate legacy schema is deliberately maintained.

ranks_plugin._comment: Deprecated compatibility profile only. Active Ranks leaderboard and profile stats use the signed Linux API; do not configure a direct website DB connection for GLOBAL_ranks.

integrations._comment: Server-side integrations. Never expose any API secret or Steam/ZarinPal credential to browser JavaScript or commit real values.

steam._comment: Steam OpenID / Steam Web API integration used by login and profile features.

faceit_api._comment: FACEIT Data API server-side key. Used only by PHP to resolve public CS2 player profiles by SteamID64; never expose this key to JavaScript.

zarinpal._comment: Payment gateway settings. Keep merchant_id empty in local development and never test real payment flows unintentionally.

weaponpaints_api._comment: Signed Linux API for WeaponPaints, SimpleAdmin, VIPCore and the read-only Ranks leaderboard. Its secret matches the root shared_secret in /etc/fragcity-api/config.php. These endpoints share this key; Pterodactyl secrets remain separate.

pterodactyl_standby_api._comment: Signed Linux API for the public CS2 Server Browser (Pterodactyl inventory + A2S_INFO). Its secret matches pterodactyl_standby.shared_secret in the Linux runtime config.

pterodactyl_monitoring_api._comment: Signed admin-only Linux API for read-only Pterodactyl/Wings monitoring. The legacy CS2 dashboard UI is not shipped. Its secret matches pterodactyl_monitoring.shared_secret on Linux and must be unique.

uptime_kuma._comment: Public read-only Uptime Kuma Status Page. Use the HTTPS origin only and a published public Status Page slug. No API key or admin password belongs here.

paymenter_backend._comment: Private HMAC connection to the FragCityAPI add-on in Paymenter. The same base_url and shared_secret secure the one-time SSO hand-off and the read-only signed /api/paymenter-profile.php endpoint. That endpoint returns only whitelisted users-table identity and Steam profile fields after matching both Paymenter user ID and SteamID64. Backend-only; never expose this secret to browser JavaScript or commit a real value.

paymenter_support._comment: Private support integration. base_url is the HTTPS Paymenter origin. admin_api_key is a Paymenter Admin API Key stored only in private settings.json. shared_secret is a separate HMAC secret configured in FragCity Support API; never reuse paymenter_backend.shared_secret and never expose either secret to the browser.

paymenter_invoices._comment: Dedicated read-only Paymenter Admin API connection for FragCity server invoice history. Use a separate API key from paymenter_support and paymenter_backend; never expose it to browser JavaScript or commit a real key.

files._comment: Per-page and per-class settings. database_profile values refer to keys under databases above; do not put passwords or API tokens in this section.

class.config._comment: WeaponPaints catalogue language, appearance and local asset paths.

images._comment: Paths are relative to the website document root. Keep the local img/weapon assets in the repository.

class.customer_db._comment: CustomerDB uses the selected website DB profile.

steam.steam_login._comment: Steam login route destinations and database ownership.

pages.zarinpal.wallet_request._comment: Website DB profile used to create a wallet payment request.

pages.zarinpal.wallet_callback._comment: Website DB profile used to verify and apply a wallet payment callback.

pages.zarinpal.vip_request._comment: Website DB profile used to create independent paid VIP orders before redirecting to ZarinPal.

pages.zarinpal.vip_callback._comment: Website DB profile used to verify ZarinPal VIP payments and mark/provision paid orders.

pages.zarinpal.buyserver_request._comment: Website DB profile for the legacy buy-server payment request page. This does not enable server provisioning by itself.

pages.zarinpal.buyserver_callback._comment: Website DB profile for the legacy buy-server payment callback. Keep server purchase disabled until the new Pterodactyl billing lifecycle is implemented.

pages.buyserveropen._comment: Website DB profile used by the public buy-server information page. This page is not a Pterodactyl provisioning API.

pages.serverlist._comment: Retained page DB profile setting for compatibility. The active Server Browser now obtains server data from pterodactyl_standby_api, not a database port-range scanner.

pages.vip._comment: The VIP storefront obtains the canonical catalogue, prices, upgrade quotes and Paymenter Wallet state from billing.fragcity.ir through the signed Paymenter bridge. RawPHP only displays VIPCore status and relays authenticated purchase/revoke requests. No local VIP purchase catalog, vip_orders table or website wallet is used for new purchases.

pages.forgot_password._comment: Password recovery remains disabled until verified-email delivery is implemented. When enabled, use the same main database profile as FragCity authentication.

pages.reset_password._comment: Password reset remains fail-closed until verified-email ownership and atomic password/token updates are implemented. Use the main FragCity authentication database.

tst.index._comment: Database profile used by the optional TST page.

database.ranks_plugin._comment: Deprecated compatibility profile. Active Ranks reads use the signed Linux API; this profile is not used by leaderboard.php or profile.php.

database.weaponpaints_plugin._comment: WeaponPaints is API-only. Keep transport set to api; do not add a direct DB profile for GLOBAL_weaponpaints.

pages.support._comment: Website DB profile for support tickets and replies.
